_comment: Cloudflare R2 lifecycle rules for the smart-laundry-backups bucket.
Implements grandfather-father-son retention by PREFIX rather than by
deleting objects from backup-databases.sh. Two reasons:
1. The CI token then needs write access only, never delete. A compromised
GitHub Actions token cannot erase backup history, which is exactly the
scenario backups exist to survive.
2. Expiry keeps working even if the backup workflow is broken or disabled.
Retention: 7 daily + 4 weekly + 3 monthly, matching roadmap item R2.
Weekly is 28 days rather than 4x7=28 exactly; monthly is 93 days to cover
three 31-day months without a fourth copy briefly overlapping.
Apply with:
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID \
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY \
AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=auto \
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration \
--endpoint-url https://$R2_ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com \
--bucket smart-laundry-backups \
--lifecycle-configuration file://scripts/r2-lifecycle.json
Note: aws s3api rejects unknown keys, so strip this _comment before applying
jq 'del(._comment)' scripts/r2-lifecycle.json > /tmp/lifecycle.json
The apply-r2-lifecycle.sh helper does this for you.
